title: Floating ZevRo Azeroth Assistant & Contextual Help
features: Replaced the assistant left-sidebar link with a clickable upper-right PC avatar, a responsive mobile-header shortcut, and a compact closable assistant panel.
Added a convenient full-page option while preserving Founder Identity and HYPER MUSIC's existing separate buttons.
Expanded curated guided-answer library to 27 documented topics, with current-studio suggestion priorities and transparent unsupported-question responses.
Assistant remains local to first-party documentation and never scans Battle.net tokens, local plans or player account data.
Updated player handbook, Getting Started, tester checklist, device QA, Gateway and release center for v7.9.8.
discord_message:
NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION v7.9.8 — Floating Assistant

NEW: ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant is now a clickable upper-right desktop avatar and a dedicated mobile-header shortcut. It opens a compact help panel with guided questions, topic suggestions, studio links and a Full Page option.

Expanded to 27 documented answer topics, with contextual suggestions based on the studio you're using—without reading private account or saved-plan data. Existing Founder and HYPER MUSIC controls remain separate.

Guides, Developer Test Requests, mobile acceptance checklist and Gateway information updated.

Preview: real-device and Blizzard API acceptance tests are still pending.

https://zevromxr-hub.github.io/nexus-application-gateway/azeroth-companion/
Powered by ZevRo Development | NEXUS
acceptance_gates: Desktop avatar doesn't overlap existing music and Founder controls
Mobile header launcher and bottom panel work on iPhone Safari
Question answering, studio links and 27 knowledge topics operate
Full Page link and Escape/Close work
No account, saved-data or OAuth regression
Outstanding real Blizzard progression tests confirmed
